verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Simular reporting per-run metrics such as success status, duration, or token/dollar cost. The claim that replayed code 'cuts tokens by up to 90%' is a cost-efficiency claim, not a per-run metrics report. 'Watch your Sai computers work' describes live visual transparency, which is a different capability. Per-run observability is a fair axis for an agent platform with an API, so the verdict is none rather than na.
